# What OpenAI API keys the library redacts, and what it leaves alone.
#
# Every key here is built from the ordered run 0123456789abcdef, which no real
# credential is, written on either side of the marker T3BlbkFJ. Those eight
# characters are the base64 encoding of OpenAI and they stand in every key
# OpenAI has issued, between two runs of random characters; a real key carries
# seventy-four or fifty-eight of those on each side, twenty for the older kind,
# and sixteen is written here because the pattern reads them as runs rather than
# to a count, so the shorter run states the same grammar and leaves a case that
# fits on a line.
#
# The two cases under the over-match heading carry no ordered run at all. They
# are not keys and nobody issued them: what they hold is a blob carrying the
# prefix and the marker and nothing key shaped between the two, which is the
# whole of what the pattern asks for.

patterns: openai-api-key

# The kinds of key, which differ only in the name a kind writes between the
# prefix and its first run — and the older kind writes none at all. The pattern
# reads that name as the opening of the run rather than from a table of names,
# so the three kinds OpenAI issues today, the kind it issued before projects
# existed and a kind nobody here has named are one shape in five spellings,
# written below in the seven places a key is written.

case: a project key in an environment assignment
in:   OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef
out:  OPENAI_API_KEY=«openai-api-key»

case: a project key in the authorization header a request carries it in
in:   Authorization: Bearer sk-proj-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef
out:  Authorization: Bearer «openai-api-key»

case: a service account key
in:   sk-svcacct-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef
out:  «openai-api-key»

case: an admin api key on a command line
in:   curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-admin-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef' https://api.openai.com/v1/organization/projects
out:  curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer «openai-api-key»' https://api.openai.com/v1/organization/projects

case: a user key with no kind behind the prefix
in:   sk-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef
out:  «openai-api-key»

case: a key naming a kind this pattern was never told about
in:   sk-service-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef
out:  «openai-api-key»

case: a key in a client side configuration object
in:   {"apiKey":"sk-proj-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef","project":"example"}
out:  {"apiKey":"«openai-api-key»","project":"example"}

# The alphabet the runs are written in. It is base64url, which is what the
# published keys carry: a project, service account or admin key holds hyphens
# and underscores among its letters and digits. The two characters standard
# base64 writes in their place, the plus and the slash, are not admitted — and
# because the run in front of the marker is what carries the prefix to it, a
# character outside the alphabet standing between the two leaves no key at all
# rather than a shorter one.

case: a run carrying a hyphen and an underscore
in:   sk-proj-0123456789abcdef-0123456789abcdef_T3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef
out:  «openai-api-key»

case: a plus between the prefix and the marker
in:   sk-proj-0123456789abcdef+T3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef
out:  sk-proj-0123456789abcdef+T3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef

case: a slash between the prefix and the marker
in:   sk-proj-0123456789abcdef/T3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef
out:  sk-proj-0123456789abcdef/T3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef

case: a space between the prefix and the marker
in:   sk-proj-0123456789abcdef T3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef
out:  sk-proj-0123456789abcdef T3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef

case: a dot between the prefix and the marker
in:   sk-proj-0123456789abcdef.T3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef
out:  sk-proj-0123456789abcdef.T3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef

# How much stands either side of the marker, which is nothing the pattern asks
# about. The two runs OpenAI writes are the same length as each other, that
# length differs by kind, and it has already been shipped at three sizes —
# twenty either side of an older key, fifty-eight either side of an admin key
# and seventy-four either side of the rest. So a count is what this scan is
# written not to read: a key whose runs are of unlike length is located whole,
# and so is one a column limit cut off the moment the marker was written.

case: runs of unlike length
in:   sk-proj-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef
out:  «openai-api-key»

case: a key cut off at the marker
in:   sk-proj-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ
out:  «openai-api-key»

case: a key cut off inside the marker
in:   sk-proj-0123456789abcdefT3Blb
out:  sk-proj-0123456789abcdefT3Blb

# What a key may be written against, and what it draws in. The prefix is the
# whole of the anchor and there is no boundary on either side of it, so a key
# keeps its span whatever word character stands in front of it. Behind it the
# redaction reaches to the end of the run, which is the price of reading a run
# rather than a count: a character of the key's own alphabet written straight
# after a key is redacted with the key, and a space, a dot or a quote is not.

case: a key after an underscore
in:   OPENAI_API_KEY_sk-proj-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef
out:  OPENAI_API_KEY_«openai-api-key»

case: a key after a letter
in:   xsk-proj-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef
out:  x«openai-api-key»

case: a key at the end of a sentence
in:   the key is sk-proj-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef.
out:  the key is «openai-api-key».

case: a key inside quotes
in:   export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-proj-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef"
out:  export OPENAI_API_KEY="«openai-api-key»"

case: a key before a hyphenated word
in:   sk-proj-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef-suffix
out:  «openai-api-key»

case: a key before a word
in:   sk-proj-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdefsuffix
out:  «openai-api-key»

# Two keys written together. The prefix is written in the alphabet a run is, so
# a key can begin inside the span of the one before it; the two spans overlap
# and are redacted as one. Written apart, both go.

case: a key beginning inside the key before it
in:   sk-sk-proj-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef
out:  «openai-api-key»

case: two keys separated by a space
in:   sk-proj-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef sk-admin-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef
out:  «openai-api-key» «openai-api-key»

# What this pattern redacts that nobody issued. The marker is the base64
# encoding of OpenAI, so base64url written over bytes holding that word at a
# position divisible by three carries those eight characters; where such a run
# also carries the prefix somewhere in front of them, everything from the prefix
# to the end of the run is redacted. That is the answer rather than a fault in
# it: what is taken is a stretch of a value already opaque to a reader, and the
# two tightenings on offer are both lists that go stale. One is a count of the
# characters either side; the other is a table of the names a kind writes behind
# the prefix, which would have located nothing on the day svcacct and admin were
# added beside proj. A stale list costs a whole key, and this costs a reader
# nothing. The pattern's own file weighs both.

case: the prefix and the marker inside a longer run of the alphabet
in:   payload=zzzzsk-zzzzT3BlbkFJzzzz
out:  payload=zzzz«openai-api-key»

case: the prefix and the marker where a signature stands
in:   eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.zzzzsk-zzzzT3BlbkFJzzzz
out:  eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.zzzz«openai-api-key»

# And what this pattern leaves alone. The first four are the marker: read in the
# case OpenAI writes it, read in all eight of its characters, asked for at all,
# and asked for behind the prefix rather than in front of it. The three after
# them are the prefix, read in its own case, in all three of its characters, and
# asked for in front of a marker that would otherwise stand alone. Of the last
# three, the hyphenated words carry the prefix and no marker, which is the whole
# of what turns them away; a digest carries neither, holding no hyphen for the
# prefix and neither a T nor a J for the marker; and no word of prose is spelled
# with either.

case: a marker in the wrong case
in:   sk-proj-0123456789abcdeft3blbkfj0123456789abcdef
out:  sk-proj-0123456789abcdeft3blbkfj0123456789abcdef

case: seven characters of the marker
in:   sk-proj-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkF0123456789abcdef
out:  sk-proj-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkF0123456789abcdef

case: a run carrying no marker at all
in:   sk-proj-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:  sk-proj-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

case: the marker in front of the prefix
in:   T3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdefsk-0123456789abcdef
out:  T3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdefsk-0123456789abcdef

case: an uppercase prefix
in:   SK-proj-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef
out:  SK-proj-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef

case: an underscore where the prefix carries a hyphen
in:   sk_proj-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef
out:  sk_proj-0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef

case: the marker with no prefix in front of it
in:   0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef
out:  0123456789abcdefT3BlbkFJ0123456789abcdef

case: a hexadecimal digest
in:   sha1=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:  sha1=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case: a line of hyphenated words
in:   the task-list and the risk-register were both reviewed
out:  the task-list and the risk-register were both reviewed

case: prose
in:   there is no credential in this sentence
out:  there is no credential in this sentence

# And an OpenAI credential this pattern has nothing to say about. A client
# secret for the Realtime API is handed to a browser and lives about a minute;
# OpenAI writes it as a value opening ek_ and states nothing else about it, so
# there is no shape here to read one by and the string comes through whole.

case: a realtime client secret
in:   {"value":"ek_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef","expires_at":1735689600}
out:  {"value":"ek_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef","expires_at":1735689600}
